brief.title: J12 connector review for Tide buoy controller
brief.issue: Prepare a review of a reported J12 link interruption during salt spray using only the supplied records.
brief.goal: Compare retaining/investigating J12 with evaluating a replacement; identify what evidence the reviewer needs.
brief.constraints: Preserve the sensor signal mapping; other constraints must come from supplied records.
brief.conditions: Synthetic bench context: a buoy telemetry bench.
brief.decision: What is the justified next action before an engineering decision?

sources.name: Tide buoy controller — note-a (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Tide buoy controller: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in a buoy telemetry bench.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during salt spray.
This observation alone does not establish a cause or suitability for operational use.
Shift note A names baseline Rev B and records 2 interruptions in 10 salt spray cycles.
